radical.title: RADICAL FRAGRANCE
radical.description: LEADING A SHIFT IN FRAGRANCE THROUGH BIOTECHNOLOGY, MASTER PERFUMERY AND 100% NATURAL INGREDIENTS.

items.collection_description: Experience our award-winning eau de parfum in a trio of pocket-sized mini perfumes.
Discover your signature scent from our collection of 100% natural perfumes, crafted by our Master Perfumer.
Explore the latest natural science and biotechnology for modern, elevated room sprays.

image_split_1.heading: A RADICAL APPROACH
image_split_1.description:
Behind every Scent Spired fragrance is a radical approach to how we operate. In a fragrance world shrouded by secrecy, we're always transparent.

In a culture fuelled by hype and excess, we favour the long view and curbing our environmental footprint. And in our use of biotechnology, guided by the artistry of our master perfumer, we create long-lasting 100% natural fragrances that eliminate the need for petrochemical-derived synthetic ingredients.

image_split_2.heading: A RADICAL APPROACH
image_split_2.description: Founded by former winemaker Frances Shoemack in 2013, Scent Inspired first emerged in Amsterdam and is now headquartered in Wellington, New Zealand. Operating across oceans, we work closely with master perfumer Isaac Sinclair and perfumer Dr Fanny Grau to create forward-thinking natural fragrances, made in good conscience.
